# Camp items that buff Endurance and where to find them in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 18, 2023
- 2 min read

Updated: Feb 13, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f6a7ff0e00724528b075210b83eed240~mv2.png)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi. Models: Swingkid, Purple69Cat, OldHag43, Cafeloco735, ScarletR4v3n

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack on top of buffs from food, chems, drinks, armour, etc.

You can not stack camp items that give the same buff ie Luck and Luck or Intelligence and Intelligence.

Camp item buffs will not stack on themselves.

__Exercise Bike__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ebafb7e4325a45598a961f998d3c5fa5~mv2.jpg)

Image credit: Mette & Cassi. Models: Swingkid, Purple69Cat, OldHag43, Cafeloco735, ScarletR4v3n

**Buff:**

+2 Endurance

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:**

Yes

**Obtained via:**

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - 1250 Bullion

Atom Shop - 500 atoms

Season 8 Scoreboard - A Better Life Underground - Free

**Build Menu Location:**

Misc. Tab

**Build Limit:**

6 per camp, shelter, or workshop.

Shares a build limit with the Exercise Bike, Weight Bench, and Antique Speed Bag.

**Flamingo Units:**

3 Flamingo Units
